After the publication of "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz" I began to receive letters from children, telling me of their pleasure in reading the story and asking me to "write something more" about the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman.

arxiv-2209-03945.title: W-Transformers : A Wavelet-based Transformer Framework for Univariate Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2209-03945.creator: Lena Sasal, Tanujit Chakraborty, Abdenour Hadid
arxiv-2209-03945.description: Abstract Deep learning utilizing transformers has recently achieved a lot of success in many vital areas such as natural language processing, computer vision, anomaly detection, and recommendation systems, among many others. Among several merits of transformers, the ability to capture long-range temporal dependencies and interactions is desirable for time series forecasting, leading to its progress in various time series applications.

arxiv-2210-14464.title: Symmetric and Nonsymmetric Macdonald Polynomials via a Path Model with a Pseudo-crystal Structure
arxiv-2210-14464.creator: Cristian Lenart, Satoshi Naito, Fumihiko Nomoto, Daisuke Sagaki
arxiv-2210-14464.description: Abstract . In this paper we derive a counterpart of the well-known Ram-Yip formula for symmetric and nonsymmetric Macdonald polynomials of arbitrary type. Our new formula is in terms of a generalization of the Lakshmibai-Seshadri paths (originating in standard monomial theory), which we call pseudo-quantum Lakshmibai-Seshadri (LS) paths.

arxiv-2302-11250.title: The Complexity of Debt Swapping
arxiv-2302-11250.creator: Henri Froese, Martin Hoefer, Lisa Wilhelmi
arxiv-2302-11250.description: Abstract A debt swap is an elementary edge swap in a directed, weighted graph, where two edges with the same weight swap their targets. Debt swaps are a natural and appealing operation in financial networks, in which nodes are banks and edges represent debt contracts. They can improve the clearing payments and the stability of these networks.

arxiv-2402-01788.title: LitLLM: A Toolkit for Scientific Literature Review Thanks: Equal contribution.
arxiv-2402-01788.creator: Shubham Agarwal*, Gaurav Sahu*, Abhay Puri*, Issam H. Laradji, Krishnamurthy DJ Dvijotham, Jason Stanley, Laurent Charlin, Christopher Pal
arxiv-2402-01788.description: Abstract Conducting literature reviews for scientific papers is essential for understanding research, its limitations, and building on existing work. It is a tedious task which makes an automatic literature review generator appealing. Unfortunately, many existing works that generate such reviews using Large Language Models (LLMs) have significant limitations.

arxiv-2501-02369.title: Predicting two-dimensional spatiotemporal chaotic patterns with optimized high-dimensional hybrid reservoir computing
arxiv-2501-02369.creator: T. Nakano, S. Baur, C. Räth
arxiv-2501-02369.description: Abstract As an alternative approach for predicting complex dynamical systems where physics-based models are no longer reliable, reservoir computing (RC) has gained popularity. The hybrid approach is considered an interesting option for improving the prediction performance of RC. The idea is to combine a knowledge-based model (KBM) to support the fully data-driven RC prediction.

arxiv-2507-17259.title: Tab-MIA: A Benchmark Dataset for Membership Inference Attacks on Tabular Data in LLMs
arxiv-2507-17259.creator: Eyal German, Sagiv Antebi, Daniel Samira, Asaf Shabtai, Yuval Elovici
arxiv-2507-17259.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained on tabular data, which, unlike unstructured text, often contains personally identifiable information (PII) in a highly structured and explicit format. As a result, privacy risks arise, since sensitive records can be inadvertently retained by the model and exposed through data extraction or membership inference attacks (MIAs).

pmc-10537906.title: Assessing inequalities in publicly funded health insurance scheme coverage and out-of-pocket expenditure for hospitalization: findings from a household survey in Kerala
pmc-10537906.creator: Santosh Kumar Sharma, Jaison Joseph, Hari Sankar D, Devaki Nambiar
pmc-10537906.description: BackgroundIncreasing financial risk protection is a key feature of Universal Health Coverage and the path towards health for all. Publicly Funded Health Insurance Schemes (PFHIS) have been considered as one of the pathways to safeguard against financial shocks and potentially reduce Out-of-Pocket Expenditure (OOPE). The south Indian state of Kerala has roughly a decade-long experience in implementing PFHIS.

pmc-11487514.title: The early diagnostic value of serum renalase level in diabetic kidney disease and diabetic macroangiopathy: a retrospective case–control study
pmc-11487514.creator: Li Jin, Wensu Wang, Rong Zhang, Jianguo Shen, Yangyang Li, Yi Zhang
pmc-11487514.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a severe complication of diabetes mellitus and is associated with an increased risk of end-stage renal disease (ESRD) and cardiovascular events. Early diagnosis and monitoring of DKD are crucial for implementing appropriate interventions.

pmc-12753993.title: Scymicrosin7–26, a Scylla paramamosain-derived novel antimicrobial peptide, exhibits efficacy against multidrug-resistant ESKAPE pathogens and anti-inflammatory activity
pmc-12753993.creator: Cong Hu, Fangyi Chen, Ying Zhou, Ting Yang, Kejian Wang, Sheng Yang, Xiangqi Chen
pmc-12753993.description: The escalating misuse of antibiotics has precipitated a worldwide crisis of bacterial resistance, greatly complicating the clinical management of multidrug-resistant bacterial infections, which now present a profound threat and a growing burden on public health systems. This situation necessitates the development of innovative anti-infective therapeutics.

pmc-12932741.title: The DMP atlas for North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany: results of the disease management programmes on district level
pmc-12932741.creator: Sabine Groos, Jens Kretschmann, Arne Weber, Michaela Assheuer, Bernd Hagen
pmc-12932741.description: Disease Management Programmes (DMP) in Germany were initiated to enhance the quality of ambulatory health care for specific chronic diseases. They aim to prevent the progression of the disease and comorbidity as well as to improve quality of life. It is the purpose of this paper to describe the contents of the web-based DMP atlas for North Rhine-Westphalia.

pmc-13068700.title: An exploratory analysis of 24-h movement behaviors in individuals with cancer completing a 12-week resistance exercise intervention
pmc-13068700.creator: B. Nakfoor, H. Parker, J. H. Leach, C. M. Fairman
pmc-13068700.description: PurposeIndividuals with cancer often experience disrupted sleep, sedentary behavior, and reduced physical activity. This exploratory analysis examined the feasibility of continuous 24-h monitoring using wrist-worn accelerometers and characterized movement behaviors during a 12-week supervised resistance training program in individuals with cancer.

pmc-13342271.title: Impact of Combined Frailty and Sarcopenia on Postoperative Outcomes and Survival in Elderly Gastric Cancer Patients Undergoing Gastrectomy
pmc-13342271.creator: Eunju Lee, Mira Yoo, Dongjae Jeon, So Hyun Kang, Tae-Han Kim, Sang-Hoon Ahn, Yun-Suhk Suh, Do Joong Park, Hyung-Ho Kim, Young Suk Park
pmc-13342271.description: PurposeFrailty and sarcopenia are associated with adverse postoperative outcomes in elderly patients undergoing gastrectomy for gastric cancer. However, large-scale evidence remains limited. This study aimed to investigate the associations of frailty and sarcopenia with postoperative outcomes and long-term survival in this population.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purposes of this part: (1) Adult The term “adult” means an individual who— (A) has attained the age of 16.

uslaw-usc-t54-s306122.title: 54 U.S.C. § 306122 — Contracts for management of historic property
uslaw-usc-t54-s306122.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s306122.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 3061 (Program Responsibilities And Authorities); Subchapter II (Lease, Exchange, Or Management Of Historic Property). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The head of any Federal agency having responsibility for the management of any historic property may, after consultation with the Council, enter into a contract for the management of the property.
